title: ICS 232 Resources at Risk Summary
description: Environmental Unit summary of the resources threatened by a release, ranked by protection priority, with the strategy and the contact for each. Built from the ESI map and the trajectory forecast. Up to 9 rows fit on the page.

marking.description: Exercise marking line shown above and below the form (defaults to EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE)

forecastBasis.description: Which trajectory forecast the ranking follows
examples: Trajectory run 04 Nov 0600, 48 h, best estimate

landfall.description: Earliest predicted contact with a listed resource
examples: 1420 on 04 Nov, Heron Bay marsh mouth

resources.description: Resources ranked for protection (priority 1 is protected first)

examples: Nesting colony; April to August closed to boats
Deflection boom, 600 ft, anchor at mouth

preparedBy.description: 6. Prepared by (Environmental Unit Leader) and date/time
